items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Well, I just prayed for him.

ctx.x: Fait Marble. Yeah, yeah. Fait Marble, yeah. Fait Marble, yeah. He had it. They came that the honor of the boat was king to faith. I know. So that's when he hold a job so long. Well, I just prayed for him. And he came out into St. Louis. Mm-hmm. Not the island got to St. Louis, but he decided to leave his father, you know, and go to New York. And that broke all the band up, you see. So we all tried to get us. I wanted to go back to Mexico, but my mother's taken sick and die. I never did go back to Mexico, you…
Ask him where did Mutt Carey go when he left Jack?
